summary: Lattice observation tower sharing the name of Bermont, a former Charlotte County sawmill town; sources give only its location, map tags and register absence, with no history or current condition.

corrections.why: T40S R26E is a land-survey township and range, not an agency. The eastern lookouts listing gives this string as the location with no agency named. Clear the field; a reviewer should decide whether any agency is documented.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. No source read gives a build date, builder, staffing, notable fires, fate, access or current condition, so the story leaves those out. The brief's agency field holds the township label T40S R26E, not an agency; see the proposed correction. The name link to the community is a matter of matching names; no source states the naming, so the story says only that the tower carries the same name. Wikipedia's Bermont article is internally inconsistent: it dates the sawmill town to the 1920s land boom but also says it received a post office in 1908. The story uses only the 1920s founding and does not mention the post office; the Charlotte County Historical Society 'Lost Towns' item that Wikipedia cites was not fetched. Brief coordinates (26.94543, -81.753447) sit close to Wikipedia's community point; no conflict found. Not checked: Florida Forest Service records for the tower. No photos found.
